title: galium parisiense var. decipiens
intro: Galium parisiense var. decipiens, commonly known as Paris Dune Bedstraw, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Paris Dune Bedstraw include wound healing, antipyretic, and analgesic effects, making it a potential treatment for minor injuries and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
